title: Session close is local fail-closed revocation
summary: AlchemyAccessControlledSession.close(reason) closes its AlchemyAccessSessionGuard. Subsequent protected METHOD checkpoints fail before Security Effect or Permission evaluation.
invariants: Closed state is checked before a new Permission decision is emitted.
Closing a session does not create or revoke a transferable token because the session is not a bearer capability.
Mutable open/closed state is not folded into the session semantic identity.

provenance.claim: Session close is in-process revocation checked at subsequent METHOD checkpoints; session state is not a transferable authority mechanism.
AlchemyAccessSessionGuard.close marks the session closed and active/validateAt enforce that state.
